Title: Manage Azure Cosmos DB in Azure Storage Explorer

Body.Content:
Using Azure Cosmos DB in Azure Storage Explorer allows users to manage Azure Cosmos DB entities, manipulate data, update stored procedures and triggers along with other Azure entities like Storage blobs and queues. Now you can use the same tool to manage your different Azure entities in one place.

Learn more.
